title: app_viewer structuredContent
description: Viewer sessions in the app, listed only while app.viewers is on (refused by this version until the owner approves them). enrol and whoami answer {person}: the person a new session's credential speaks for (null: the code was not accepted), or the calling credential's (null: the app's own token, the household view). end answers {ended}. See contracts/README.md section 2.2.
